description_en: Queries the list of SSL certificates available to the user on APIG
description_zh: 查询用户侧APIG可用的SSL证书列表
name: ListSslCerts

parameters.help_en: The AgentTeams instance ID. This parameter is used to verify the ownership of the instance for the current user and to query certificates in the region of the instance
parameters.help_zh: AgentTeams 实例 ID，用于校验当前用户实例归属，并使用实例 region 查询证书
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of records to return in this request
parameters.help_zh: 本次请求返回的最大记录数
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token used to retrieve the next page of data
parameters.help_zh: 分页标记，用于获取下一页数据
parameters.name: next_token
